Additionally, his German is listed as basic while the role requires strong verbal and written German, and Java appears only marginally in his background, with his core expertise in TypeScript/Node.js and DLang.

Strong agile and craftsmanship practices (TDD, pairing, CI/CD, trunk-based development)
Relevant degree in computer science and proven cloud/DevOps exposure (AWS, Kubernetes, Docker)
